name: Errors
description: Collect the log lines that contain an error from another running service, so they are in one place.

actions.title: Watch for errors
actions.description: Follow the logs of another action's current run and add each line that contains the pattern to the Errors view. Waits and tries again when that action is not running.

target.description: The action to follow, as plugin.action.

pattern.description: Case-insensitive text to look for. No leading dash.
